description: Original reusable style grammars and starter prompt recipes. External reference entries live in resources.json.

styles.name: Cut-paper theatre
styles.visual_language: Layered matte paper silhouettes with visibly torn edges, warm parchment shadows, hinged limb motion, limited horizontal stage depth, soft side lighting.
styles.prompt_seed: Keep 3–5 depth planes; move cutouts through rotation, sliding and replacement poses; maintain paper grain and character silhouette.
styles.avoid: Perfect digital gradients, photorealistic faces, elastic anatomy

styles.name: Black silhouette / red accent
styles.visual_language: Near-total black figure against bone-white or pitch-black space; decisive negative space; only eyes or a single symbol use red.
styles.prompt_seed: Use held poses, one intentional camera change, then a timed eye-color reveal; preserve exact head shape.
styles.avoid: Neon glow everywhere, over-animated limbs, busy sets

styles.name: Sumi-e ink wash
styles.visual_language: Breathing white paper, variable brush pressure, dry-brush edges, transparent wash, minimal grayscale, rare vermilion seal.
styles.prompt_seed: Compose with 60% negative space and one expressive gesture; let ink density define depth.

styles.name: Woodcut print
styles.visual_language: High-contrast carved contours, rough parallel hatching, limited earthy inks, flattened perspective and bold silhouettes.
styles.prompt_seed: Build value with gouged line density and negative space, not airbrush gradients.

styles.name: Risograph collage
styles.visual_language: Misregistered two-to-three ink colors, halftone texture, cropped found-paper shapes, imperfect photocopy edges.
styles.prompt_seed: Animate only independent paper layers; retain the offset registration.

styles.name: Hand-painted cel animation
styles.visual_language: Disciplined outlines, stepped exposure, flat value groups, painted backgrounds, hand-placed highlights, expressive key poses.
styles.prompt_seed: Lock character model, mouth/eye charts and light direction; stage anticipation, action and reaction.

styles.name: Seinen ink and screentone
styles.visual_language: Expressive black brush contours, layered screentones, irregular gutters, strong black masses, restrained speed lines.
styles.prompt_seed: Use varying shot sizes and character acting; reserve white space for readable lettering.

styles.name: Minimal flat-vector
styles.visual_language: Simple geometric forms, crisp silhouettes, few solid colors, deliberate easing, no false material depth.
styles.prompt_seed: Assign one purpose to each color and motion; keep silhouettes recognizable at phone size.

styles.name: Watercolor storybook
styles.visual_language: Wet-on-wet pigment blooms, imperfect paper grain, subtle pencil underdrawing, soft luminous washes.
styles.prompt_seed: Paint environment as atmospheric washes and preserve consistent character landmarks.

styles.name: Expressionist film noir
styles.visual_language: Motivated single-source side lighting, controlled black areas, fog only with purpose, asymmetrical framing, hard architecture.
styles.prompt_seed: Design shots by what is withheld or revealed; keep eyelines and light geography consistent.

styles.name: 16-bit pixel art
styles.visual_language: Fixed pixel grid, readable clusters, limited palette, intentional dithering, consistent isometric or side-view projection.
styles.prompt_seed: Specify asset dimensions, pivot and animation state; inspect at native zoom.

styles.name: Handmade clay stop motion
styles.visual_language: Tactile fingerprints, miniature sets, practical shadows, imperfect edges, stepped pose changes.
styles.prompt_seed: Preserve physical mass, contact and prop scale in successive frames.

styles.name: Naturalistic travel commercial
styles.visual_language: Documentary-style camera, real sky and skin tones, believable reflections, motivated lens and clear spatial geography.
styles.use_for: Travel ads, ferry scenes, destination reveals
styles.prompt_seed: Establish geography and a human motive before revealing location; edit to action and sound.

styles.name: Editorial kinetic typography
styles.visual_language: Typographic hierarchy, single family with weight contrast, precise grids, rhythmic cuts and purposeful text movement.
styles.prompt_seed: Time each reveal to a new word or beat; hold key phrases long enough to read.

prompts.title: Cut-paper philosophical exchange
prompts.template: A 12-second 2D cut-paper theatre scene. On a quiet ochre battlefield at dusk, two clearly identifiable characters face each other in profile: [TEACHER] and [STUDENT]. The student asks [QUESTION] while keeping one hand tightened; the teacher answers [ANSWER] as their palm opens slowly. Three paper depth planes, visible cut edges, restrained shadow gaps, jointed pose changes and no camera movement until the final 2-second pullback. Continuity: identical silhouettes, costume colors, props and light direction in every shot. Include timed intelligible dialogue and quiet cloth/paper foley.
prompts.notes: Stage poses separately, then animate controlled layers; dialogue must drive gesture.
prompts.origin: original starter recipe; not scraped from external galleries

prompts.title: Minimal red-eye reveal
prompts.template: An almost motionless black kneeling silhouette occupies the lower third of an empty off-white stage. A single low voice says [CONFESSION]. Hold 2 seconds in absolute stillness. On the final words [DEMAND], the head rises by 4 degrees and only the two eye shapes turn saturated red. Do not change face outline or costume silhouette. Hard cut to silence. 8 seconds, 24 fps, one camera setup.
prompts.notes: Strength comes from restraint and the delayed alteration, not effects.
prompts.origin: original starter recipe; not scraped from external galleries

prompts.title: Manga emotional reaction sequence
prompts.template: One page of six right-to-left manga panels: [CHARACTER] learns [FACT] while trying not to show emotion. Panel 1: establish geography. Panel 2: the other person's small gesture. Panel 3: the hand gripping a prop. Panel 4: a close-up with a 1 mm change around the eyes. Panel 5: a wide silent panel with negative space. Panel 6: a choice shown through action, not a speech bubble. Black brush ink, controlled screentone, legible empty lettering zones. Preserve costume and prop ownership.
prompts.notes: Read in order without captions first; show a consequential change.
prompts.origin: original starter recipe; not scraped from external galleries

prompts.title: Human-first ferry travel ad
prompts.template: A grounded 8-second destination ad. 0–2 s: [HUMAN PROBLEM] shown through a readable action in a real environment. 2–4 s: a visual match-cut motivated by that action. 4–7 s: reveal a real ferry traversing clear Andaman water, with believable scale, wake, hull geometry and sunlight. 7–8 s: clean CTA [BRAND]. Shoot like a travel documentary, preserve identity/wardrobe across cut, let sea and wind audio lead music.
prompts.notes: Verify geography, boat scale and visual match before final export.
prompts.origin: original starter recipe; not scraped from external galleries

prompts.title: Sumi-e hero illustration
prompts.template: [CHARACTER] pauses at [PLACE] before [ACTION], viewed from a low three-quarter angle. One dark dry-brush contour and two light wash planes describe the body; a distant mountain dissolves into open paper. Reserve blank space above the gesture, single vermilion detail, cold gray ink on textured rice paper, 4:5. Do not render facial photorealism.
prompts.notes: One clear focal gesture; check silhouette at thumbnail size.
prompts.origin: original starter recipe; not scraped from external galleries

prompts.title: Cel-animated action key poses
prompts.template: Animate [CHARACTER] choosing to [ACTION] against [OPPONENT] as three readable beats: 0–1 s anticipation and shift of weight; 1–2 s fast decisive action on a coherent arc with 2 expressive smears; 2–3 s reaction and contact settle. 2D hand-painted cels over a stable painted background, fixed outfit and model sheet, stable screen direction, no automatic texture morphing.
prompts.notes: Test contact frame and motion arc before extending the shot.
prompts.origin: original starter recipe; not scraped from external galleries

prompts.title: Kinetic type for one sentence
prompts.template: 9:16 vertical type-only motion graphic, 6 seconds. Display [SENTENCE] in four semantic clauses with one clean sans-serif type family and two weights. New clause enters only on corresponding syllable; previous words remain for context except at a purposeful emotional turn. Restrained black, warm white and one accent. 20% title-safe margins, crisp export. Include deliberate silence or [SOUND] cue.
prompts.notes: Review at phone size; audio synchronization is part of acceptance.
prompts.origin: original starter recipe; not scraped from external galleries

prompts.title: Coherent pixel character spritesheet
prompts.template: Create a production 16-bit game sprite sheet for [CHARACTER] at native [WIDTH]x[HEIGHT] per pose: idle 4, walk 6, action 4, recovery 2. Stable palette of <=16 colors, same ground contact line and pivot in every cell, recognizable silhouette, consistent light from upper left, transparent background, no blurry upscaling. Include a tiny test room frame for in-game readability.
prompts.notes: Check native grid, cell alignment and state transitions.
prompts.origin: original starter recipe; not scraped from external galleries

prompts.title: Risograph collage poster
prompts.template: Create a 4:5 editorial poster about [THEME] using cut-paper geometry, a two-ink risograph palette (deep ultramarine and vermilion), physical halftone texture, controlled 1 mm color misregistration and one visual metaphor [METAPHOR]. Asymmetrical composition with a strong empty-text zone. No glossy gradients, no arbitrary assets.
prompts.notes: Concept and type hierarchy must survive black-and-white preview.
prompts.origin: original starter recipe; not scraped from external galleries

prompts.title: Noir visual reveal
prompts.template: A 10-second noir scene in [LOCATION]. [CHARACTER] must decide whether to [DECISION]. Begin with a wide composition where an architectural shadow hides the crucial object; motivate a single lateral camera shift that reveals it without changing the light source or room geography. Hard side light, restrained sound, meaningful last-frame eyeline. No gratuitous fog or lens flare.
prompts.notes: The camera reveals information, not decorative movement.
prompts.origin: original starter recipe; not scraped from external galleries
